## Context / Problem
The MCP server hand-copies two contracts the codebase already owns. Its 48 library-backed tools are closures that re-declare each `rebar.*` signature (`src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, `_mcp_writes.py`), guarded only by a name-level parity script, test, and 919-line manifest that cannot see shape drift (three undeclared input divergences exist today). Its output shapes are 32 pydantic models in `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py` (619 LOC) mirroring `src/rebar/schemas/*.json`, policed by `check_mcp_models.py` and 339 LOC of drift tests; bug lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird (3a02-66ea-9229-470c) still found 41 drifted properties and schema-violating nulls on the wire. Ticket topaz-blubbery-mice (c996-8a5f-5123-4f8e) rejected generated adapters for all three surfaces; the operator ruled (2026-09-06) to override that for MCP only, in stages, with an ADR (0119; 0118 was taken by adaptive-snapshot-cadence) that supersedes the clause for MCP and leaves the CLI under ADR 0100. Experiments on origin/main 083620b0 (recorded in the stories) confirmed the FastMCP mechanism for advertising canonical schemas, measured the null-vs-absent wire delta, and enumerated every deliberate divergence for the override table.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every public library callable in `rebar.__all__` has a complete parameter annotation. Checked by the census test in the annotation story.
- [x] Every MCP tool that advertises an `outputSchema` advertises the canonical `src/rebar/schemas/*.json` content verbatim, results carry only what the library emits, and `rebar._mcp_models` plus `check_mcp_models.py` and their drift tests no longer exist. Checked by the diff and wire tests in the schema story.
- [x] The 48 library-backed tools are produced by one factory from the annotated signatures plus an explicit override table, with input schemas, descriptions, and annotations byte-identical to the pre-derivation server; the name-only parity script, test, and manifest are deleted. Checked by the golden-surface test in the derivation story.
- [x] ADR 0119 records the MCP-only supersession of topaz-blubbery-mice's no-generated-adapters clause, and release notes list every field that was null and is now absent. Checked by the ADR gates and the release-notes review in `make verify`.

## Child decomposition
- S1 annotate the 84 unannotated library parameters: criterion 1.
- S2 advertise canonical JSON schemas and delete the pydantic mirror: criterion 2 and the release-notes half of criterion 4; depends on S1.
- S3 derive the 48 tools from the annotated signatures, delete the parity gate, write ADR 0119: criterion 3 and the ADR half of criterion 4; depends on S2.
